name: x-framing-badges
description: Unpacked Manifest V3 extension that badges how an X post is framed. Rules only. It scores framing, not truth.

scripts.build: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/render-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/build-fixture.mjs && node scripts/build-zip.mjs
